questions.text: एक वृत्त के एक चतुर्थांश के क्षेत्रफल का उस वृत्त के क्षेत्रफल से अनुपात है :
questions.text_english: The ratio of the area of a quadrant of a circle to the area of a circle is :
questions.solution: A quadrant is one-fourth of a circle. The area of a full circle is πr² and the area of a quadrant is (1/4)πr². Therefore, the ratio of the area of a quadrant to the area of the full circle is (1/4)πr² : πr² = 1 : 4. Option C is correct. Options A, B, and D are incorrect as they do not represent this one-fourth relationship.
questions.solution_hindi: एक चतुर्थांश वृत्त का चौथाई भाग होता है। पूर्ण वृत्त का क्षेत्रफल πr² तथा चतुर्थांश का क्षेत्रफल (1/4)πr² होता है। अतः अनुपात = 1 : 4 होगा।

questions.text: एक शंकु जिसकी ऊँचाई 'h' तथा त्रिज्या 'r' है, उसी त्रिज्या के अर्धगोले पर अध्यारोपित है। कुल ठोस का संपूर्ण पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल होगा :
questions.text_english: A cone of height 'h' and radius 'r' is surmounted on a hemisphere of same radius. The total surface area of the entire solid will be :
questions.solution: When a cone is surmounted on a hemisphere of the same radius r, the total surface area consists of the curved surface area of the cone plus the curved surface area of the hemisphere. The slant height of the cone is l = √(h²+r²). Curved surface area of cone = πrl = πr√(h²+r²). Curved surface area of hemisphere = 2πr². The base of the hemisphere is not exposed, and the base of the cone merges with the flat face of the hemisphere, so the total surface area = πr√(h²+r²) + 2πr². Hence option C is correct.
questions.solution_hindi: शंकु का वक्र पृष्ठ = πrl = πr√(h²+r²), अर्धगोले का वक्र पृष्ठ = 2πr²। कुल पृष्ठ = πr√(h²+r²) + 2πr²।
questions.topic: Total Surface Area of Combined Solids

questions.text: बहुलक के सूत्र बहुलक = l + [(f₁ - f₀)/(2f₁ - f₀ - f₂)] × h में f₁ दर्शाता है :
questions.text_english: In the formula of mode given by mode = l + [(f₁ - f₀)/(2f₁ - f₀ - f₂)] × h, f₁ denotes the :

options.B: बहुलक वर्ग से ठीक पहले वाले वर्ग की बारंबारता
options.C: बहुलक वर्ग के ठीक बाद में आने वाले वर्ग की बारंबारता

options_english.B: frequency of class preceding modal class
options_english.C: frequency of class succeeding modal class

questions.solution: In the mode formula, l is the lower limit of the modal class, f₁ is the frequency of the modal class, f₀ is the frequency of the class preceding the modal class, f₂ is the frequency of the class succeeding the modal class, and h is the class width. Therefore, f₁ denotes the frequency of the modal class. Option A is correct.
questions.solution_hindi: बहुलक सूत्र में f₁ बहुलक वर्ग की बारंबारता को दर्शाता है। अतः विकल्प A सही है।

questions.text: किसी बंटन के लिए, यदि माध्य = माध्यक = a है, तो इस बंटन का बहुलक है :
questions.text_english: For a distribution, if mean = median = a, then its mode is :
questions.solution: Using the empirical relationship: Mode = 3 × Median − 2 × Mean. Given that Mean = Median = a, we substitute: Mode = 3a − 2a = a. So the mode is also equal to a. This makes sense because when mean = median = mode, the distribution is perfectly symmetric. Option C is correct.
questions.solution_hindi: सूत्र से: बहुलक = 3 × माध्यक − 2 × माध्य = 3a − 2a = a। अतः विकल्प C सही है।
questions.topic: Relationship between Mean, Median and Mode

questions.text: तीन पासों को एक साथ फेंकने पर संभव परिणामों की कुल संख्या है :
questions.text_english: The total number of outcomes in the experiment of simultaneous throw of three dice is :
questions.solution: Each die has 6 faces showing numbers 1 to 6. When three dice are thrown simultaneously, the total number of outcomes is 6 × 6 × 6 = 216. Option D is correct. Options A (6), B (18), and C (36) correspond to throwing one, and partial combinations, not three dice simultaneously.
questions.solution_hindi: एक पासे के 6 परिणाम होते हैं। तीन पासों के लिए कुल परिणाम = 6 × 6 × 6 = 216। अतः विकल्प D सही है।

questions.text: दो संख्याओं 3 और 5 के लिए, (HCF − LCM) का मान है :
questions.text_english: The value of (HCF − LCM) for the two numbers 3 and 5 is :
questions.solution: For the numbers 3 and 5, since both are prime numbers, their HCF = 1 and their LCM = 3 × 5 = 15. Therefore, HCF − LCM = 1 − 15 = −14. Option D is correct. Options A, B, and C are incorrect as they do not account for the correct HCF and LCM values.
questions.solution_hindi: 3 और 5 के लिए HCF = 1, LCM = 15। HCF − LCM = 1 − 15 = −14। अतः विकल्प D सही है।

questions.text: किसी प्राकृत संख्या n के लिए, यदि संख्या aⁿ सदैव अंक a पर समाप्त होती है, तो 'a' का संभव मान है :
questions.text_english: If the number aⁿ, where n is a natural number, always ends with digit a, then the possible value of 'a' is :
questions.solution: We need a number a such that aⁿ always ends with digit a for any natural number n. Checking: 6¹=6, 6²=36, 6³=216 — all end in 6. So a = 6 satisfies this condition. For a = 2: 2²=4 (ends in 4, not 2). For a = 4: 4²=16 (ends in 6, not 4). For a = 8: 8²=64 (ends in 4, not 8). Hence option C (6) is correct.
questions.solution_hindi: 6¹=6, 6²=36, 6³=216 — सभी 6 पर समाप्त होते हैं। अतः a=6 सही है। विकल्प C सही है।

questions.text: समीकरण निकाय x = a, x = b (a ≠ b) के हलों की संख्या है :
questions.text_english: The number of solutions of the system of equations x = a, x = b (a ≠ b) is :
questions.solution: The equations x = a and x = b represent two vertical lines parallel to the y-axis. Since a ≠ b, these two lines are different parallel lines that never intersect. A system of parallel lines has no common point, therefore the number of solutions is 0. Option A is correct.
questions.solution_hindi: x = a और x = b (a ≠ b) दो समानांतर रेखाएं हैं जो कभी नहीं मिलतीं। अतः हलों की संख्या 0 है। विकल्प A सही है।
questions.chapter: Pair of Linear Equations in Two Variables

questions.text: 'p' का एक मान जिसके लिए px² + 4x + p = 0 के मूल वास्तविक और बराबर हैं, है :
questions.text_english: One of the values of 'p' for which px² + 4x + p = 0 has real and equal roots is :
questions.solution: For equal roots, the discriminant must be zero: b² − 4ac = 0. Here a = p, b = 4, c = p. So 4² − 4(p)(p) = 0, giving 16 − 4p² = 0, so 4p² = 16, p² = 4, p = ±2. From the given options, p = 2 (option C) is correct. Note p = −2 is also a valid solution mathematically but is not listed as an option.
questions.solution_hindi: समान मूलों के लिए: b² − 4ac = 0 ⇒ 16 − 4p² = 0 ⇒ p² = 4 ⇒ p = ±2। विकल्पों में से p = 2। अतः विकल्प C सही है।

questions.text: निम्नलिखित समीकरणों में से कौन-सा द्विघात समीकरण है ?
questions.text_english: Which of the following equations is a quadratic equation ?
questions.solution: Expanding option B: (x−1)(x+2) = x²+x−2 and 2x+1 on the right. So x²+x−2 = 2x+1, giving x²−x−3 = 0, which is a quadratic equation. Option A: x²=(x+1)² simplifies to 0=2x+1, a linear equation. Option C: (x+2)³=2x(x²−1) gives a cubic equation. Option D: √x=x² is not a standard polynomial equation. Hence option B is correct.
questions.solution_hindi: विकल्प B: (x−1)(x+2)=2x+1 सरल करने पर x²−x−3=0 प्राप्त होता है जो द्विघात समीकरण है। अतः विकल्प B सही है।

questions.text: मूल-बिन्दु से बिन्दु (2, 3) की दूरी है :
questions.text_english: The distance of the point (2, 3) from the origin is :
questions.solution: Using the distance formula, distance from origin (0,0) to point (2,3) is √[(2−0)²+(3−0)²] = √[4+9] = √13. Option D is correct. Options A (2) and B (3) are just the individual coordinates, and option C (5) would require coordinates like (3,4).

questions.text: बिन्दुओं (1, 3) और (1, −3) को मिलाने वाले रेखाखंड का मध्य-बिन्दु स्थित है :
questions.text_english: The mid-point of the line segment joining points (1, 3) and (1, −3) lies :

options.B: दूसरे चतुर्थांश में / in the second quadrant

questions.solution: Using the midpoint formula, the midpoint of (1, 3) and (1, −3) is ((1+1)/2, (3+(−3))/2) = (1, 0). The point (1, 0) lies on the x-axis because its y-coordinate is 0. Option C is correct. It is not the origin (which requires both coordinates to be 0).
questions.solution_hindi: मध्य-बिन्दु = ((1+1)/2, (3−3)/2) = (1, 0)। y-निर्देशांक 0 होने से यह x-अक्ष पर है। अतः विकल्प C सही है।

questions.text: दी गई आकृति में, यदि DE ∥ BC, AD = 1·5 cm, DB = 3 cm और EC = 2 cm है, तो AC की लम्बाई है :
questions.text_english: In the given figure, if DE ∥ BC, AD = 1·5 cm, DB = 3 cm and EC = 2 cm, the length of AC is :
questions.image_description: Triangle ABC with a line DE parallel to BC. D is on AB and E is on AC. AD = 1.5 cm, DB = 3 cm, EC = 2 cm are marked.
questions.solution: By Basic Proportionality Theorem (Thales' theorem), since DE ∥ BC, AD/DB = AE/EC. So 1.5/3 = AE/2, giving AE = (1.5 × 2)/3 = 1 cm. Therefore AC = AE + EC = 1 + 2 = 3 cm. Option B is correct.
questions.solution_hindi: BPT से: AD/DB = AE/EC ⇒ 1.5/3 = AE/2 ⇒ AE = 1 cm। AC = AE + EC = 1 + 2 = 3 cm। अतः विकल्प B सही है।

questions.text: दो संकेन्द्रित वृत्तों में, छोटे वृत्त की स्पर्श-रेखा बड़े वृत्त को काटती है :
questions.text_english: In two concentric circles, a tangent to the smaller circle will intersect the larger circle at :
questions.solution: A tangent to the smaller circle touches it at exactly one point and is a straight line that extends in both directions. Since the larger circle has a bigger radius and is concentric, this tangent line will be a secant (chord) to the larger circle, cutting it at exactly two points. Option C is correct.
questions.solution_hindi: छोटे वृत्त की स्पर्श-रेखा एक सरल रेखा होती है जो बड़े वृत्त को दो बिंदुओं पर काटती है। अतः विकल्प C सही है।

questions.text_english: The value of (2 tan 60°)/(1 − tan² 60°) is :
questions.solution: We know that tan 60° = √3. Substituting: (2×√3)/(1−(√3)²) = (2√3)/(1−3) = (2√3)/(−2) = −√3. Also note that the formula 2tanθ/(1−tan²θ) = tan 2θ, so this equals tan 120° = −√3. Option D is correct.

questions.text: (sec θ − cos θ)² + sin² θ − tan² θ = ?
questions.text_english: (sec θ − cos θ)² + sin² θ − tan² θ = ?
questions.solution: Expanding (sec θ − cos θ)² = sec²θ − 2sec θ·cos θ + cos²θ = sec²θ − 2 + cos²θ. So the full expression = sec²θ − 2 + cos²θ + sin²θ − tan²θ. Since sin²θ + cos²θ = 1 and sec²θ − tan²θ = 1, this becomes: (sec²θ − tan²θ) + (sin²θ + cos²θ) − 2 = 1 + 1 − 2 = 0. Option A is correct.
questions.solution_hindi: (secθ−cosθ)²+sin²θ−tan²θ = sec²θ−2+cos²θ+sin²θ−tan²θ = (sec²θ−tan²θ)+(sin²θ+cos²θ)−2 = 1+1−2 = 0। अतः विकल्प A सही है।

questions.text: जब सूर्य का उन्नयन 30° से 60° में बदलता है तो एक मीनार की छाया की लम्बाई :
questions.text_english: The length of the shadow of a tower when the sun's altitude changes from 30° to 60° will :
questions.solution: Let the height of the tower be h. At angle of elevation 30°, shadow length = h/tan 30° = h√3. At angle of elevation 60°, shadow length = h/tan 60° = h/√3. Since h/√3 < h√3, the shadow becomes shorter as the sun's altitude increases from 30° to 60°. Option A is correct.
questions.solution_hindi: 30° पर छाया = h√3, 60° पर छाया = h/√3। चूँकि h/√3 < h√3, छाया छोटी हो जाती है। अतः विकल्प A सही है।

questions.text: दी गई आकृति में, छायांकित भाग निरूपित करता है :
questions.text_english: In the given figure, the shaded region represents :
questions.image_description: A circle with centre O. The shaded region is the larger region below a chord, i.e., the major segment of the circle (the region between the chord and the major arc).
questions.solution: A segment is the region between a chord and the arc. A major segment is the larger region (between the chord and the major arc). The shaded region in the figure is the larger part of the circle divided by the chord, which is the major segment. It is not a sector (which would include radii). Option D is correct.
questions.solution_hindi: जीवा और चाप के बीच का क्षेत्र वृत्तखंड कहलाता है। बड़ा वृत्तखंड दीर्घ वृत्तखंड होता है। अतः विकल्प D सही है।

questions.text:
अभिकथन (A) : 36 को विभाजित करने वाली अभाज्य संख्याएँ 6 को भी विभाजित करती हैं।
तर्क (R) : कोई संख्या यदि p² को विभाजित करती है, तो वह p को भी विभाजित करती है।
questions.text_english:
Assertion (A): The prime numbers which divide 36 also divide 6.
Reason (R): Any number which divides p² also divides p.
questions.instruction_line: निम्नलिखित कूटों में से सही उत्तर चुनिए।
questions.instruction_line_english: Select the correct answer from the codes given below.

options.A: अभिकथन (A) और तर्क (R) दोनों सही हैं और तर्क (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या करता है।
options.B: अभिकथन (A) और तर्क (R) दोनों सही हैं, परन्तु तर्क (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं करता है।
options.C: अभिकथन (A) सही है, परन्तु तर्क (R) गलत है।
options.D: अभिकथन (A) गलत है, परन्तु तर्क (R) सही है।

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.

questions.solution: Assertion A: 36 = 2² × 3². Its prime factors are 2 and 3. And 6 = 2 × 3, which is also divisible by 2 and 3. So A is true. Reason R: If a number divides p², it also divides p (this is a property of prime divisors — if a prime divides p², it must divide p). R is true and it correctly explains why primes dividing 36 also divide 6 (since 36 = 6²). Hence both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation. Option A is correct.
questions.solution_hindi: A सत्य: 36 के अभाज्य गुणनखंड 2 और 3 हैं, जो 6 को भी विभाजित करते हैं। R सत्य: यदि कोई अभाज्य p² को विभाजित करती है तो p को भी। R, A की सही व्याख्या करता है। अतः विकल्प A सही है।

questions.text:
अभिकथन (A) : सभी सर्वांगसम त्रिभुज, समरूप त्रिभुज होते हैं।
तर्क (R) : सर्वांगसम त्रिभुजों में, संगत भुजाओं का अनुपात 1 : 1 होता है।
questions.text_english:
Assertion (A): All congruent triangles are similar.
Reason (R): In congruent triangles, the ratio of corresponding sides is 1 : 1.
questions.instruction_line: निम्नलिखित कूटों में से सही उत्तर चुनिए।
questions.instruction_line_english: Select the correct answer from the codes given below.

options.A: अभिकथन (A) और तर्क (R) दोनों सही हैं और तर्क (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या करता है।
options.B: अभिकथन (A) और तर्क (R) दोनों सही हैं, परन्तु तर्क (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं करता है।
options.C: अभिकथन (A) सही है, परन्तु तर्क (R) गलत है।
options.D: अभिकथन (A) गलत है, परन्तु तर्क (R) सही है।

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.

questions.solution: Assertion A: Congruent triangles have equal corresponding angles and equal corresponding sides, so they are also similar (similarity requires equal angles and proportional sides). Since the ratio is 1:1, they satisfy similarity conditions. A is true. Reason R: In congruent triangles, corresponding sides are equal, so their ratio is 1:1. R is true and it directly explains why congruent triangles are similar. Option A is correct.
questions.solution_hindi: A सत्य: सर्वांगसम त्रिभुज समरूप भी होते हैं क्योंकि उनके कोण बराबर होते हैं। R सत्य: संगत भुजाओं का अनुपात 1:1 होता है। R, A की सही व्याख्या है। अतः विकल्प A सही है।

questions.instruction_line: निम्नलिखित में से कोई एक करें।
questions.instruction_line_english: Attempt any one of the following.

sub_questions.text: एक बड़े वृत्त के त्रिज्यखण्ड, जिसका केन्द्रीय कोण 120° है, का क्षेत्रफल एक छोटे वृत्त के क्षेत्रफल के बराबर है। छोटे वृत्त और बड़े वृत्त की त्रिज्याएँ क्रमशः 'r' और 'R' हैं। r : R ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: The area of a smaller circle is equal to the area of a sector of a larger circle with central angle 120°. The radii of the smaller and larger circles are 'r' and 'R' respectively. Find r : R.

key_points: Equating: πr² = πR²/3, so r²/R² = 1/3, thus r:R = 1:√3

sub_questions.solution: Area of sector of larger circle with central angle 120° = (120/360) × πR² = πR²/3. Area of smaller circle = πr². Setting them equal: πr² = πR²/3. Dividing both sides by π: r² = R²/3, so r²/R² = 1/3. Taking square root: r/R = 1/√3. Therefore r : R = 1 : √3.

sub_questions.text: दी गई आकृति में, त्रिज्या 7 cm के वृत्त का केन्द्र O है। AB, वृत्त की एक जीवा है। छायांकित भाग का परिमाप ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: In the given figure, O is the centre of a circle of radius 7 cm. AB is a chord of the circle. Find the perimeter of the shaded region.
sub_questions.image_description: Circle with centre O and radius 7 cm. A chord AB subtends an angle of 60° at the centre O. The shaded region is the minor segment (between chord AB and the minor arc AB).

key_points: Since central angle = 60° and OA=OB=7, triangle OAB is equilateral, so AB = 7 cm
Perimeter = arc AB + chord AB = 22/3 + 7 = 22/3 + 21/3 = 43/3 cm

sub_questions.solution: The central angle ∠AOB = 60° and radius = 7 cm. Length of arc AB = (60/360) × 2π × 7 = (1/6) × 2 × (22/7) × 7 = 22/3 cm. Since ∠AOB = 60° and OA = OB = 7 cm, triangle OAB is equilateral, so chord AB = 7 cm. Perimeter of shaded region = arc AB + chord AB = 22/3 + 7 = 22/3 + 21/3 = 43/3 cm ≈ 14.33 cm.

questions.solution: See sub-questions for detailed solutions.

questions.instruction_line_english: Attempt any one of the following.

sub_questions.text: c का मान ज्ञात कीजिए जिसके लिए निम्नलिखित रैखिक समीकरण युग्म के अपरिमित रूप से अनेक हल हैं : cx + 3y = c − 3 तथा 12x + cy = c
sub_questions.text_english: Find the value of c for which the following pair of linear equations has infinitely many solutions: cx + 3y = c − 3 and 12x + cy = c

key_points: For infinitely many solutions: a1/a2 = b1/b2 = c1/c2
From c/12 = 3/c: c² = 36, c = ±6; checking c = 6 satisfies all three ratios

sub_questions.solution: For infinitely many solutions, the condition is a₁/a₂ = b₁/b₂ = c₁/c₂. Here a₁ = c, b₁ = 3, c₁ = −(c−3); a₂ = 12, b₂ = c, c₂ = −c. So c/12 = 3/c, giving c² = 36, c = ±6. Also checking 3/c = (c−3)/c: 3c = c(c−3), giving c−3 = 3, so c = 6. Verifying: 6/12 = 3/6 = 3/6 = 1/2. All ratios are equal. Therefore c = 6.

sub_questions.text: x और y के लिए हल कीजिए : 3x + 2y = 65 तथा 2x + 3y = 60
sub_questions.text_english: Solve for x and y: 3x + 2y = 65 and 2x + 3y = 60

key_points: Adding and subtracting equations to eliminate variables

sub_questions.solution: Given: 3x + 2y = 65 ...(1) and 2x + 3y = 60 ...(2). Multiplying (1) by 3 and (2) by 2: 9x + 6y = 195 and 4x + 6y = 120. Subtracting: 5x = 75, so x = 15. Substituting in (1): 3(15) + 2y = 65, 45 + 2y = 65, 2y = 20, y = 10. Therefore x = 15 and y = 10.

questions.text: त्रिभुज ABC की भुजा BC पर एक बिंदु D इस प्रकार स्थित है कि ∠ADC = ∠BAC. सिद्ध कीजिए कि (CA)² = CB · CD.
questions.text_english: D is a point on side BC of △ABC such that ∠ADC = ∠BAC. Prove that (CA)² = CB · CD.

key_points: So CB/CA = CA/CD, giving (CA)² = CB · CD

questions.solution: In △BAC and △ACD: ∠BAC = ∠ADC (given) and ∠C is common to both triangles. By AA similarity criterion, △BAC ~ △ACD. Since corresponding sides of similar triangles are proportional: CB/CA = CA/CD. Cross-multiplying: CA × CA = CB × CD, which gives (CA)² = CB · CD. Hence proved.
questions.solution_hindi: △BAC और △ACD में: ∠BAC = ∠ADC (दिया है), ∠C = ∠C (उभयनिष्ठ)। AA से △BAC ~ △ACD। अतः CB/CA = CA/CD ⇒ (CA)² = CB·CD। सिद्ध हुआ।

questions.text: दी गई आकृति में, एक वृत्त के परिगत त्रिभुज ABC बना है। यदि AR = 3 cm, BP = 4 cm तथा QC = 5 cm है, तो त्रिभुज ABC का परिमाप ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english: In the given figure, △ABC circumscribes a circle. If AR = 3 cm, BP = 4 cm and QC = 5 cm, find the perimeter of △ABC.

key_points: Tangent lengths from external point are equal: AR=AQ=3, BP=BR=4, QC=CP=5
AB = AR+BR = 3+4=7, BC = BP+CP=4+5=9, CA = AQ+QC=3+5=8

questions.image_description: Triangle ABC with an inscribed circle touching AB at R, BC at P, and CA at Q. AR = 3 cm, BP = 4 cm, QC = 5 cm are marked.
questions.solution: Since tangents drawn from an external point to a circle are equal in length: From A: AR = AQ = 3 cm. From B: BP = BR = 4 cm. From C: CP = CQ = 5 cm. Therefore AB = AR + BR = 3 + 4 = 7 cm, BC = BP + CP = 4 + 5 = 9 cm, CA = CQ + AQ = 5 + 3 = 8 cm. Perimeter of △ABC = AB + BC + CA = 7 + 9 + 8 = 24 cm.
questions.solution_hindi: बाह्य बिंदु से स्पर्श-रेखाएँ बराबर: AQ=AR=3, BR=BP=4, CP=CQ=5। AB=7, BC=9, CA=8। परिमाप = 24 cm।

questions.text: मान ज्ञात कीजिए : sin²45° / (cosec²30° − tan²45°)
questions.text_english: Evaluate: sin²45° / (cosec²30° − tan²45°)
questions.solution: Using standard trigonometric values: sin 45° = 1/√2, so sin²45° = 1/2. cosec 30° = 2, so cosec²30° = 4. tan 45° = 1, so tan²45° = 1. Substituting: sin²45° / (cosec²30° − tan²45°) = (1/2) / (4 − 1) = (1/2) / 3 = 1/6.

questions.text: निम्नलिखित त्रिकोणमितीय सर्वसमिका को सिद्ध कीजिए : (cos A − 2cos³A) / (2sin³A − sin A) = cot A
questions.text_english: Prove the following trigonometric identity: (cos A − 2cos³A) / (2sin³A − sin A) = cot A

key_points: Take cos A common from numerator: cos A(1−2cos²A)
Take sin A common from denominator: sin A(2sin²A−1)
Simplify to get cos A/sin A = cot A

questions.solution: Taking cos A common from the numerator: cos A(1 − 2cos²A). Taking sin A common from the denominator: sin A(2sin²A − 1). Note that 1 − 2cos²A = 1 − 2(1−sin²A) = 2sin²A − 1. Therefore the expression becomes [cos A × (2sin²A − 1)] / [sin A × (2sin²A − 1)]. Cancelling (2sin²A − 1) from numerator and denominator (provided it is non-zero): = cos A / sin A = cot A. Hence proved.
questions.solution_hindi: अंश में cos A सामान्य: cos A(1−2cos²A) = cos A(2sin²A−1)। हर में sin A सामान्य: sin A(2sin²A−1)। (2sin²A−1) कट जाता है। शेष: cosA/sinA = cot A। सिद्ध हुआ।

questions.text: संयोग (chance) के एक खेल में, एक पहिये को घुमाया जाता है, जो विश्राम में आने के बाद संख्याओं 1, 2, 3, …, 10 में से किसी एक संख्या को इंगित करता है। यदि सभी परिणाम समप्रायिक हैं, तो इसकी क्या प्रायिकता है कि यह पहिया : (i) 2 से बड़ी अभाज्य संख्या को इंगित करेगा? (ii) 9 से छोटी विषम संख्या को इंगित करेगा? (iii) 4 के गुणज को इंगित करेगा?
questions.text_english: A game of chance consists of spinning a wheel which comes to rest at one of the numbers from 1 to 10 (as shown in the given figure) with equal probabilities. What is the probability that the wheel stops at (i) a prime number greater than 2? (ii) an odd number less than 9? (iii) a multiple of 4?
questions.image_description: A spinning wheel divided into 10 equal sectors numbered 1 to 10.
questions.solution: Total number of equally likely outcomes = 10. (i) Prime numbers greater than 2 from 1 to 10 are: 3, 5, 7. Favourable outcomes = 3. P(prime > 2) = 3/10. (ii) Odd numbers less than 9 from 1 to 10 are: 1, 3, 5, 7. Favourable outcomes = 4. P(odd < 9) = 4/10 = 2/5. (iii) Multiples of 4 from 1 to 10 are: 4, 8. Favourable outcomes = 2. P(multiple of 4) = 2/10 = 1/5.

sub_questions.text: सिद्ध कीजिए कि √5 एक अपरिमेय संख्या है।
sub_questions.text_english: Prove that √5 is an irrational number.

key_points: Then 5q² = p², so 5 divides p, let p = 5m
Both p and q divisible by 5 contradicts HCF = 1

sub_questions.solution: Assume √5 is rational. Then √5 = p/q where p and q are integers with HCF(p, q) = 1 and q ≠ 0. Squaring both sides: 5 = p²/q², so p² = 5q². This means 5 divides p², and since 5 is prime, 5 divides p. Let p = 5m. Then p² = 25m², so 5q² = 25m², giving q² = 5m². This means 5 divides q² and hence 5 divides q. But then both p and q are divisible by 5, which contradicts HCF(p, q) = 1. Therefore √5 is irrational.

sub_questions.text: अंकगणित का आधारभूत प्रमेय लिखिए और इसके प्रयोग से, 36 और 54 का ल.स. (LCM) ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: State the Fundamental Theorem of Arithmetic and use it to find LCM of 36 and 54.

key_points: Every composite number can be expressed as a product of primes uniquely

sub_questions.solution: Fundamental Theorem of Arithmetic: Every composite number can be expressed (factorised) as a product of primes, and this factorisation is unique, apart from the order in which the prime factors occur. Using prime factorisation: 36 = 2² × 3² and 54 = 2 × 3³. LCM = product of each prime factor raised to its highest power = 2² × 3³ = 4 × 27 = 108.

questions.topic: Irrational Numbers and Fundamental Theorem of Arithmetic

questions.text: बहुपद q(x) = 6x² − 5x − 1 के शून्यक ज्ञात कीजिए और q(x) के शून्यकों तथा इसके गुणांकों के बीच संबंध को सत्यापित कीजिए।
questions.text_english: Find the zeroes of the polynomial q(x) = 6x² − 5x − 1 and verify the relationship between the zeroes of q(x) and its coefficients.
questions.solution: Factorising q(x) = 6x² − 5x − 1: 6x² − 6x + x − 1 = 6x(x−1) + 1(x−1) = (6x+1)(x−1). Setting each factor to zero: x = 1 or x = −1/6. The zeroes are α = 1 and β = −1/6. Verification: Sum of zeroes = 1 + (−1/6) = 5/6 = −(−5)/6 = −b/a ✓. Product of zeroes = 1 × (−1/6) = −1/6 = c/a ✓. The relationship between zeroes and coefficients is verified.

sub_questions.text: निम्नलिखित रैखिक समीकरण युग्म को ग्राफ़ द्वारा हल कीजिए : 2x − y = 2 और 4x − y = 4। इन समीकरणों से निरूपित रेखाएँ y-अक्ष को जिन बिंदुओं पर प्रतिच्छेदित करती हैं, उन बिंदुओं के निर्देशांक भी लिखिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Solve graphically the following pair of linear equations: 2x − y = 2 and 4x − y = 4. Also, write the coordinates of the points where the lines represented by these equations cut the y-axis.

key_points: Plot both lines using table of values

sub_questions.solution: For 2x − y = 2: when x = 0, y = −2; when x = 1, y = 0; when x = 2, y = 2. For 4x − y = 4: when x = 0, y = −4; when x = 1, y = 0; when x = 2, y = 4. Plotting these points and drawing both lines, they intersect at (1, 0). Therefore x = 1, y = 0 is the solution. Line 2x−y=2 cuts the y-axis at (0, −2). Line 4x−y=4 cuts the y-axis at (0, −4).

questions.text: दी गई आकृति में, TP और TQ, वृत्त के बिन्दुओं P और Q पर क्रमशः स्पर्श-रेखाएँ हैं। यदि प्रतिवर्ती ∠POQ = 250° है, तो चतुर्भुज POQT के प्रत्येक कोण की माप ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english: In the given figure, TP and TQ are tangents at points P and Q of the circle respectively. If reflex ∠POQ = 250°, find the measure of each angle of quadrilateral POQT.
questions.image_description: Circle with centre O. T is an external point. TP and TQ are tangents from T touching the circle at P and Q respectively. The reflex angle POQ = 250° is marked at centre O.
questions.solution: The reflex ∠POQ = 250°, so the non-reflex ∠POQ = 360° − 250° = 110°. Since TP and TQ are tangents at P and Q, the radius is perpendicular to the tangent at the point of contact. Therefore ∠OPT = 90° and ∠OQT = 90°. In quadrilateral POQT: sum of all angles = 360°. So ∠PTQ = 360° − ∠OPT − ∠OQT − ∠POQ = 360° − 90° − 90° − 110° = 70°. Thus the angles of POQT are: ∠POQ = 110°, ∠OPT = 90°, ∠OQT = 90°, ∠PTQ = 70°.

sub_questions.text: एक पौधे की 40 पत्तियों की लम्बाइयाँ निकटतम मिलीमीटर में मापी जाती हैं तथा प्राप्त आँकड़ों को निम्नलिखित सारणी के रूप में निरूपित किया जाता है : [100-120: 8, 120-140: 9, 140-160: 12, 160-180: 5, 180-200: 6]। पत्तियों की माध्यक लम्बाई (mm में) ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: The lengths of 40 leaves of a plant are measured, correct to the nearest millimetre and data obtained is represented in the following table: [100-120: 8, 120-140: 9, 140-160: 12, 160-180: 5, 180-200: 6]. Find the median length (in mm) of the leaves.
sub_questions.solution: Total leaves n = 40, so n/2 = 20. Cumulative frequencies: 100-120: 8; 120-140: 8+9=17; 140-160: 17+12=29; 160-180: 29+5=34; 180-200: 34+6=40. The cumulative frequency just exceeding 20 is 29, so the median class is 140-160. Here l = 140, cf = 17 (preceding cumulative frequency), f = 12, h = 20. Median = l + [(n/2 − cf)/f] × h = 140 + [(20−17)/12] × 20 = 140 + [3/12] × 20 = 140 + 5 = 145 mm.

sub_questions.text: दो वर्गों के क्षेत्रफलों का योगफल 2650 cm² है। यदि उनके परिमापों का योगफल 280 cm है, तो दिए गए दो वर्गों की भुजाएँ ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: The sum of areas of two squares is 2650 cm². If the sum of their perimeters is 280 cm, find the sides of the two given squares.

key_points: Let sides be x and y: x²+y²=2650, 4x+4y=280 → x+y=70

sub_questions.solution: Let the sides of the two squares be x cm and y cm. Sum of areas: x² + y² = 2650 ...(1). Sum of perimeters: 4x + 4y = 280, so x + y = 70, thus y = 70 − x ...(2). Substituting (2) in (1): x² + (70−x)² = 2650, x² + 4900 − 140x + x² = 2650, 2x² − 140x + 2250 = 0, x² − 70x + 1125 = 0. Factorising: (x−45)(x−25) = 0, so x = 45 or x = 25. If x = 45, y = 25. If x = 25, y = 45. The sides of the two squares are 45 cm and 25 cm.

sub_questions.text: समीकरण 1/x − 1/(x−2) = 3, (x ≠ 0, 2) को एक द्विघात समीकरण के मानक रूप में व्यक्त कीजिए। अतः, इस प्रकार प्राप्त हुए द्विघात समीकरण के मूल ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Express the equation 1/x − 1/(x−2) = 3, (x ≠ 0, 2) as a quadratic equation in standard form. Hence, find the roots of the quadratic equation so obtained.
sub_questions.solution: Starting with 1/x − 1/(x−2) = 3: [(x−2)−x] / [x(x−2)] = 3, giving −2 / [x(x−2)] = 3. Cross-multiplying: −2 = 3x(x−2) = 3x²−6x. Rearranging: 3x² − 6x + 2 = 0. This is the standard form. Using the quadratic formula: x = [6 ± √(36−24)] / 6 = [6 ± √12] / 6 = [6 ± 2√3] / 6 = (3 ± √3)/3. Therefore x = (3+√3)/3 or x = (3−√3)/3.

questions.text: "आधारभूत समानुपातिकता प्रमेय" लिखिए और सिद्ध कीजिए।
questions.text_english: State and prove the "Basic Proportionality Theorem."

key_points: Statement: If a line is drawn parallel to one side of a triangle intersecting the other two sides, then it divides the two sides in the same ratio
Draw DE ∥ BC in △ABC, join BE and CD, draw DM⊥AC and EN⊥AB
Since △BDE and △CDE are on same base DE between same parallels, ar(△BDE)=ar(△CDE)

questions.solution: Statement (Basic Proportionality Theorem / Thales' Theorem): If a line is drawn parallel to one side of a triangle to intersect the other two sides in distinct points, the other two sides are divided in the same ratio. Given: In △ABC, DE ∥ BC where D is on AB and E is on AC. To Prove: AD/DB = AE/EC. Construction: Join BE and CD. Draw EN ⊥ AB and DM ⊥ AC. Proof: Area of △ADE = (1/2) × AD × EN. Area of △BDE = (1/2) × DB × EN. So ar(△ADE)/ar(△BDE) = AD/DB ...(i). Similarly, ar(△ADE) = (1/2) × AE × DM. ar(△CDE) = (1/2) × EC × DM. So ar(△ADE)/ar(△CDE) = AE/EC ...(ii). Since DE ∥ BC, triangles BDE and CDE lie between the same parallel lines DE and BC on the same base DE. Therefore ar(△BDE) = ar(△CDE) ...(iii). From (i), (ii), and (iii): AD/DB = AE/EC. Hence proved.
questions.solution_hindi: कथन: यदि एक रेखा त्रिभुज की एक भुजा के समांतर खींची जाए, तो वह अन्य दो भुजाओं को एक ही अनुपात में विभाजित करती है। सिद्धि: △ADE और △BDE के क्षेत्रफलों का अनुपात AD/DB है। △ADE और △CDE के क्षेत्रफलों का अनुपात AE/EC है। DE ∥ BC होने से △BDE = △CDE। अतः AD/DB = AE/EC। सिद्ध हुआ।

questions.text: एक गोलाकार काँच के बर्तन की एक बेलनाकार गर्दन है जिसकी लम्बाई 7 cm है और व्यास 2 cm है जबकि गोलाकार भाग का व्यास 14 cm है। इस सम्पूर्ण काँच के बर्तन की धारिता ज्ञात कीजिए। (π = 22/7 प्रयोग कीजिए)
questions.text_english: A spherical glass vessel has a cylindrical neck which is 7 cm long and 2 cm in diameter. The diameter of the spherical part is 14 cm. Find the capacity of the entire glass vessel. (Use π = 22/7)

key_points: Cylinder: r=1 cm, h=7 cm; Volume = πr²h = 22/7×1×7 = 22 cm³

questions.solution: The cylindrical neck has diameter 2 cm so radius r = 1 cm and height h = 7 cm. Volume of cylinder = πr²h = (22/7) × 1² × 7 = 22 cm³. The spherical part has diameter 14 cm so radius R = 7 cm. Volume of sphere = (4/3)πR³ = (4/3) × (22/7) × 7³ = (4/3) × (22/7) × 343 = (4 × 22 × 343) / 21 = 30184/21 = 1437.33 cm³. Total capacity = 22 + 1437.33 = 1459.33 cm³ ≈ 1459⅓ cm³.
questions.solution_hindi: बेलन: r=1 cm, h=7 cm। आयतन = 22 cm³। गोला: R=7 cm। आयतन = (4/3)×(22/7)×343 = 1437⅓ cm³। कुल = 1459⅓ cm³।

questions.text: एक मैदान आयताकार है। इस आयताकार मैदान ABCD के चारों कोनों के निर्देशांक A(10, 10), B(40, 10), C(40, 50) और D(x, y) हैं। दो दोस्त अनिल और अनिता ने एक दौड़ लगाने का फैसला किया। अनिता ने बिंदु A से दौड़ना शुरू किया और वह बिन्दु E की ओर, विकर्ण AC की दिशा में, चल पड़ी, जहाँ E, ABCD के दोनों विकर्णों का प्रतिच्छेद बिन्दु है। बिन्दु E पर पहुँचकर, वह बिन्दु B की ओर, विकर्ण DB की दिशा में जाती है और बिन्दु B पर पहुँचने पर वह BA की दिशा में जाकर बिन्दु A पर वापस आती है। अनिल बिंदु C से आरम्भ करके, D से होते हुए बिन्दु A तक दौड़ लगाता है।
questions.text_english: A field is in the form of a rectangle. The coordinates of the rectangular field ABCD are A(10, 10), B(40, 10), C(40, 50) and D(x, y). Anil and Anita, two friends decided to have a race. Anita started from point A and moved to point E along the diagonal AC, where E is the point of intersection of both the diagonals of ABCD. From point E, she moved to point B along the other diagonal DB and then moved back to point A along BA. While Anil started from point C and ran to point A via D along the boundary of the field.
questions.instruction_line: उपर्युक्त जानकारी के आधार पर, निम्नलिखित प्रश्नों के उत्तर दीजिए।
questions.instruction_line_english: Based on the above information, answer the following questions.

sub_questions.text: बिंदु E के निर्देशांक ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Find the coordinates of point E.

key_points: E is midpoint of diagonal AC: E = ((10+40)/2, (10+50)/2) = (25, 30)

sub_questions.solution: E is the point of intersection of the diagonals of rectangle ABCD, which means E is the midpoint of diagonal AC. Using midpoint formula: E = ((10+40)/2, (10+50)/2) = (50/2, 60/2) = (25, 30).

sub_questions.text: बिंदुओं B और C के बीच की दूरी ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Find the distance between the points B and C.
Attempt any one: (a) Find the coordinates of point D and the distance BD. OR (b) Find the total distance travelled by Anita.

key_points: (a) D is such that ABCD is a rectangle: D=(10,50). BD=√[(40-10)²+(10-50)²]=√[900+1600]=√2500=50 units
(b) Anita travels: AE + EB + BA. AC=√[(40-10)²+(50-10)²]=50, so AE=25. EB=25. BA=30. Total=25+25+30=80 units

sub_questions.solution: (a) In rectangle ABCD, A=(10,10), B=(40,10), C=(40,50). D must be such that ABCD is a rectangle. Since AB is horizontal (y=10) and BC is vertical (x=40), D has x-coordinate same as A = 10 and y-coordinate same as C = 50. So D = (10, 50). Distance BD = √[(40−10)² + (10−50)²] = √[900 + 1600] = √2500 = 50 units. (b) Anita travels A→E→B→A. AC = √[(40−10)²+(50−10)²] = √[900+1600] = 50 units, so AE = 25 units. Similarly EB = 25 units. AB = √[(40−10)²+(10−10)²] = 30 units. Total = 25 + 25 + 30 = 80 units.

questions.text: पतंग उत्सव भारत में एक लोकप्रिय त्योहार है जो मकर संक्रांति के दौरान मनाया जाता है। यह त्योहार लोगों द्वारा अपनी छतों से पतंग उड़ाकर मनाया जाता है। रीना और रवि भी त्योहार का आनंद लेने के लिए पतंग उड़ा रहे हैं। रीना की पतंग की ऊँचाई धरती से 60 m ऊपर है। पतंग से जुड़ी डोर अस्थायी रूप से धरती पर एक बिंदु से बँधी होती है, और धरती के साथ डोर का झुकाव 30° है। रवि 10 m ऊँची इमारत से पतंग उड़ा रहा है। उसकी पतंग भी धरती से 60 m ऊपर उड़ रही है और रवि द्वारा इस्तेमाल की गई डोर की लम्बाई रीना की डोर के समान है। θ, छत के एक बिन्दु से रवि की पतंग का उन्नयन कोण है।
questions.text_english: Kite festival is a popular festival in India which takes place during Makar Sankranti. The festival is celebrated by people flying kites from their rooftops. Reena and Ravi are also flying kites to enjoy the festival. The height of Reena's kite is 60 m above the ground. The string attached to the kite is temporarily tied to a point on the ground, and the inclination of the string with the ground is 30°. Ravi is flying a kite from a 10 m high building. His kite is also flying 60 m above the ground and the length of the string used by Ravi is same as that of Reena's. θ is the angle of elevation of Ravi's kite from a point on the rooftop.
questions.instruction_line: उपर्युक्त जानकारी के आधार पर, निम्नलिखित प्रश्नों के उत्तर दीजिए।
questions.instruction_line_english: Based on the above information, answer the following questions.

sub_questions.text: रीना द्वारा इस्तेमाल करने वाली डोर की लम्बाई ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Find the length of string used by Reena.
sub_questions.solution: Reena's kite is 60 m above the ground and the string makes an angle of 30° with the ground. Using trigonometry: sin 30° = opposite/hypotenuse = 60/L. Since sin 30° = 1/2, we get 1/2 = 60/L, so L = 120 m. The length of Reena's string is 120 m.

sub_questions.text: sin θ का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Find the value of sin θ.

key_points: Ravi is on 10m building, kite at 60m. Effective height = 60−10 = 50 m. String = 120 m. sin θ = 50/120 = 5/12

sub_questions.solution: Ravi is on a 10 m high building and his kite is 60 m above the ground. The effective height of the kite above the rooftop = 60 − 10 = 50 m. The string length = 120 m (same as Reena's). sin θ = opposite/hypotenuse = 50/120 = 5/12.

sub_questions.text_english: Attempt any one: (a) If θ changes to 60°, without changing the length of the string, what will be the height of Ravi's kite above the ground? (Use √3 = 1·7) OR (b) What would have been the height of Ravi's kite above the ground, if the string had an inclination of 30° with the ground, assuming that the length of the string does not change?

key_points: (a) sin 60° = h/120 → h = 120×(√3/2) = 60√3 = 60×1.7 = 102 m above rooftop. Height above ground = 102+10 = 112 m
(b) sin 30° = h/120 → h = 120×(1/2) = 60 m above rooftop. Height above ground = 60+10 = 70 m

sub_questions.solution: (a) If θ = 60°, string length = 120 m. Height above rooftop = 120 × sin 60° = 120 × (√3/2) = 60√3 = 60 × 1.7 = 102 m. Height above ground = 102 + 10 = 112 m. (b) If inclination = 30°, string = 120 m. Height above rooftop = 120 × sin 30° = 120 × (1/2) = 60 m. Height of kite above ground = 60 + 10 = 70 m.

questions.text: एक महिला ने अपनी दोस्त से ₹10,00,000 उधार लिए और अगले महीने से मासिक किस्तों में उधार लिया हुआ पैसा वापस करने का वादा किया। एक महीने पश्चात, उसने ₹10,000 वापस किए, अगले महीने उसने ₹15,000 वापस किए, तीसरे महीने में उसने ₹20,000 वापस किए और इसी तरह प्रत्येक महीने की किस्त में समान रूप से वृद्धि करते हुए वापस करती रही।
questions.text_english: A woman borrowed ₹10,00,000 from her friend and promised to return the borrowed money in monthly instalments beginning from the next month. After one month, she returned ₹10,000, the next month she returned ₹15,000, the third month she returned ₹20,000 and so on, thereby increasing the monthly instalment uniformly.
questions.instruction_line: उपर्युक्त जानकारी के आधार पर, निम्नलिखित प्रश्नों के उत्तर दीजिए।
questions.instruction_line_english: Based on the above information, answer the following questions.

sub_questions.text: दसवें महीने में भुगतान की गई किस्त की राशि ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Find the amount of instalment paid in the tenth month.
sub_questions.solution: The instalments form an AP with first term a = ₹10,000 and common difference d = ₹15,000 − ₹10,000 = ₹5,000. The nth term is aₙ = a + (n−1)d. So the 10th instalment = 10000 + (10−1) × 5000 = 10000 + 45000 = ₹55,000.

sub_questions.text: कौन-सी किस्त में उसने ₹40,000 का भुगतान किया था?
sub_questions.text_english: In which instalment did she pay ₹40,000?
Attempt any one: (a) If she returned ₹11,50,000 in all, how many instalments did she pay? OR (b) By which instalment has she returned a total amount of ₹3,25,000?
